notes.title: Balance, bug fixes and event updates
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors.
A maintenance period will soon begin to improve game stability, adjust balance, and initiate a compensation event for the issues you have experienced so far. Please see the details below.

[Maintenance Time]
- - 2024/10/25 21:00 ~ 23:00(UTC)
- Maintenance may end early.

[Maintenance Details]
Balance Adjustments
Attack Power and Defense Ratings 
→ Charge attack power for all weapons has been slightly reduced.
→ Damage reduction based on defense rating has been slightly reduced.

Bartender
→ Material costs for crafting “Recovery Drink” have been adjusted.
→ Health recovery from directly consuming “Recovery Drink” has been reduced.
→ Material costs for crafting “Wave of Sweetness” have been adjusted.
→ Health recovery from directly consuming “Wave of Sweetness” has been reduced.
→ Health recovery from throwing “Wave of Sweetness” has been reduced.
→ The description of the Bartender's 'Drink Physique' perk, which mentioned "Defense Rating +40", has been removed as it did not match the actual effect of the perk.

Unintended Issue Fixes
- The bug allowing unlimited use of consumable items has been fixed.
- The issue preventing the purchase of material items at the marketplace has been fixed.
- Crow's poison damage now applies correctly.
- The Bartender's drink “Dark In Darker” no longer causes permanent blindness when hit.

Compensation and Triple Exp Event
- A one-time“Trophy of Atonement” will be added to the inventory of the first created character per account as a compensation reward.
- This trophy can be traded and stored in container storage.
- Before entering the game, please ensure to store it in the container or sell it to the sponsor vendor Aisha Green to receive 100,000 gold reward.
- Once lost, the Trophy of Atonement cannot be restored, so please handle it with care.
- After the maintenance period and until the end of the public test, all characters will receive triple experience points.

Once maintenance is completed, we will inform you via a separate announcement.
Thank you very much for participating in the public test, and we would appreciate your continued participation and feedback for the remaining period.

notes.title: Public Test 2nd Update Maintenance Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, survivors.
We will be conducting maintenance to address the known issues.
Through this maintenance, we aim to resolve various issues within the game and improve your gameplay experience.
Please make sure to check the maintenance schedule so you don't lose any loot obtained from your escapes.

[Maintenance Schedule]
- 2024/10/23 12:00 ~ 15:00(UTC)
- 3 hours
*The maintenance may conclude early depending on the situation.

[Maintenance Details]
● Explosive Traps
→ The recoverable distance has been adjusted, and now you can recover explosive traps by approaching slowly.
→ When recovering explosive traps, the exact number will be retrieved.

● Zombies
→ The issue where zombies ignored players and looked elsewhere while attacking will be improved.
: Now, zombies will actively recognize and attack players.
→ The issue that allowed players to reliably evade zombie attacks using specific terrain has been fixed.
: Contrary to our original intent, we will modify it so that zombies cannot be easily defeated using specific terrain.

● Bartender
→ New class: The Bartender's "Sweet Champagne" now works correctly.
: After using Sweet Champagne, if you are within the skill range, all healing effects will apply correctly.

● Other Work 
→ Additional server stability and data improvement work will be carried out.
: This includes efforts to stabilize the server and mitigate unstable elements.

We will notify you separately once the maintenance is complete.
We appreciate your continued interest and participation during the remaining time, and please do not hesitate to provide feedback and report any bugs.
Thank you for participating in the public test.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795540/The_Midnight_Walkers/

notes.title: Public test version update maintenance notice
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors,

To ensure a smooth gameplay environment in The Midnight Walkers, we will be conducting maintenance to address ongoing unintended issues.

[Maintenance Schedule]
- Start: 2024/10/22 12:00 (UTC)
- End: 2024/10/22 14:00 (UTC)
- Duration: 2 hours (may finish early depending on circumstances)

[Maintenance Details]
▶Character
- Increased Crow's backstep skill range
- Bartender's potion now correctly applies when thrown

▶Zombie
- AI tweaks and improvements
- Adjusted Tanker Zombie's attack speed
- Reduced the number of Tanker Zombie spawns

▶Other
- Adjusted placement of certain terrain objects
- Reduced the drop rate of high-tier items
- Reduced the drop rate of keys and keycards
- Removed some chair objects lying on the floor of the 7th floor
- Modified the crate structure in the boss zombie combat zone
- Improved the squad invite button infinite loading issue
- Server optimization and stabilization
- Other various fixes based on feedback

Once the maintenance is complete, we will notify you through a separate announcement. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and greatly appreciate your participation in the public playtest. Please continue to support and engage with us in the remaining time.

Thank you.
